name: orbit-monorepo
description: Orbit - Local AI Coding Agent Runtime

scripts.test:deepseek: node scripts/testing/run.mjs packages/model-providers/src/deepseek packages/model-providers/src/transport/ProviderSseParser.test.ts packages/model-providers/src/ToolArguments.test.ts packages/model-providers/src/ModelAdaptation.test.ts packages/model-providers/src/openai-compatible/OpenAICompatibleProvider.test.ts packages/model-providers/src/anthropic-compatible/AnthropicCompatibleProvider.test.ts packages/model-providers/src/request/CanonicalRequest.test.ts packages/core/src/agent/AgentLoopRouting.test.ts packages/core/src/agent/ContextWindowManager.test.ts packages/cli/src/commands/bench.test.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/ProviderBenchmarks.test.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/ProviderDiagnostics.test.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/ProviderFactory.test.ts packages/config/src/Credentials.test.ts packages/config/src/ConfigLoader.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:dependencies && pnpm verify:architecture && pnpm verify:docs && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck:source && pnpm verify:skills && pnpm test
scripts.verify:cli: node scripts/lint.mjs "packages/cli/src/**/*.ts" && pnpm exec dprint check "packages/cli/src/**/*.{ts,md}" packages/cli/README.md && pnpm test:cli && pnpm --filter @orbit-build/cli build
scripts.verify:webui: pnpm typecheck:webui-client && node scripts/lint.mjs "packages/cli/src/runtime/webui/**/*.ts" packages/cli/src/runtime/RunCoordinator.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/RunCoordinator.test.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/CommandRouter.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/ReplController.ts packages/cli/src/tui/FullscreenTui.ts && pnpm exec dprint check "packages/cli/src/runtime/webui/**/*.{ts,md}" packages/cli/src/runtime/RunCoordinator.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/RunCoordinator.test.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/CommandRouter.ts packages/cli/src/runtime/ReplController.ts packages/cli/src/tui/FullscreenTui.ts && pnpm test:webui && pnpm --filter @orbit-build/cli build
scripts.verify:skills: node packages/cli/dist/index.js skills validate --deep --directory @orbit/builtin-skills --json && pnpm test:cumcm-skill:quick
scripts.verify:package: pnpm --filter @orbit-build/cli build && pnpm smoke:cli && node scripts/verify-cli-package.mjs
scripts.verify:release:core: pnpm verify && pnpm verify:docs && pnpm test:coverage:critical && pnpm smoke:cli && pnpm smoke:install && pnpm verify:runtime-budgets && pnpm audit:prod && pnpm audit:all && pnpm notices:check && node scripts/verify-cli-package.mjs
scripts.audit:all: pnpm audit --audit-level low && node scripts/audit-development-bundles.mjs && node scripts/audit-browser-bundle.mjs
